```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# remotes::install_github("rundel/ghclass")
library(ghclass)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
```

```{r}
org_outside_collaborators <- function(org) {
  ghclass:::ghclass_api_v3_req(endpoint = "GET /orgs/:org/outside_collaborators", org = org) %>%
    purrr::map_chr("login")
}
```


```{r}
ghorg <- "Calvin-DS202-FA20"
(members <- org_members(ghorg))
students <- members %>% setdiff(org_admins(ghorg))
students <- union(students, org_outside_collaborators(ghorg))
paste(students, collapse = " ") %>% cat()
```

# Set up assignment templates

```{r}
org_sitrep(ghorg)
```


```{r eval=FALSE}
assignment_src <- "lab/lab01-hello"
system2("git", "ls-files", stdout = TRUE) %>%
  tibble(filename = .) %>%
  filter(str_detect(filename, assignment_src)) %>%
  extract(filename, "basename", paste0(assignment_src, "/(.*)"))
```


## Set up an assignment

```{r}
assignmentName <- "lab01-hello"
assignmentPath <- glue("lab/{assignmentName}")
repo_name <- glue("{ghorg}/{assignmentName}")
repo_create(org = ghorg, name = assignmentName, gitignore_template = "")
```

```{r}
system()
```



```{r create-template-repo eval=FALSE}
template_name <- "hw10-validation"
template_files <- "hw10-validation/hw10-validation.Rmd"

# Create template repo (if it doesn't exist)
repo_name <- org_repos(ghorg, paste0(template_name, "$"))
if (length(repo_name) == 0) {
  repo_create(ghorg, template_name)
  repo_name <- org_repos(ghorg, template_name)

  # Add some files to the template repo
  repo_add_file(repo_name, file = template_files)

  # Now go to GitHub and make it a template repo
  cat(glue::glue("https://github.com/{repo_name}"))
}
stopifnot(length(repo_name) == 1)
```

# Harvest Student Work

```{r}
all_repos <- org_repos(ghorg)
assignmentName <- "hw01"
assignments_root <- "../fa20/"

# Clone or update repos for all students
students %>% purrr::walk(function(student) {
  student_repo_name <- paste0(assignmentName, "-", student)
  student_repo_fullname <- paste0(ghorg, "/", student_repo_name)
  assignment_path <- file.path(assignments_root, assignmentName)
  repo_path <- file.path(assignment_path, student_repo_name)
  if (file.exists(repo_path)) {
    # Update (pull)
    local_repo_pull(repo_path)
  } else if (student_repo_fullname %in% all_repos) {
    # Clone
    local_repo_clone(
      repo = student_repo_fullname,
      local_path = assignment_path,
      verbose = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    message(paste0("Missing ", assignmentName, " for ", student))
  }
})
```
